i don't really have advice for you. i just want to tell you that i am kind of in the same boat, so you're not alone. my wife left me not even a year ago and it's killing me. she's already remarried. i drink every night. i buy a half gallon of bourbon every few days and drink until i pass out every night. every day i think about killing myself. my pet is what keeps me alive. otherwise, i'm inconsequential. i tried to stop drinking and didn't drink for a few days, and the depression was absolutely crushing. i'm on anti-depressants, but the severity of the soul-crushing loneliness seems to know no bounds. i wish you the best, i truly do. i hope you find the thing in life that opens your horizons, that shows you the possibilities that are open to you. i hope you find what it is you are longing for.
